result.summary:
Blocked. The gate passes only with one small addition to aegis-wasm, which is outside this unit's write scope. I wrote the patch and a report instead of committing it: /home/patrickd/aegis/.claude/worktrees/wf_2f5d4f1c-c31-1/subjects/p2-subject/aegis-wasm-fi.patch and /home/patrickd/aegis/.claude/worktrees/wf_2f5d4f1c-c31-1/subjects/p2-subject/INFEASIBLE_REPORT.md.

Why it is blocked: the isolation-fi guest exports handle(id, fault) and imports env.host_fault. The committed aegis-wasm can only run F14 handle() -> i32 modules, takes no inputs, links no host functions and does not re-export wasmtime. So p2-subject, which may only have path dependencies, cannot run that guest. The patch adds crates/aegis-wasm/src/fi.rs behind test-hooks: no unsafe, no new dependency, the existing digest-checked load, and a fresh instance per call. It also needs a one-line path-only Cargo.lock re-lock (p2-subject -> aegis-wasm). `git apply --check` passes on the commit. Until the patch is applied, p2-subject does not build on this commit.

Results with the patch applied (uncommitted) on the laptop, Linux 6.17.0-14, Landlock ABI 7, load average in brackets:
- isolation-fi --trials 3 --path forkwasm, gate timing mode: PASS with no retries [5.0]. 0 healthy failures and 0 wrong answers on all 8 fault classes, 72-100 faults injected per class. Recovery p99 in us: panic 685, abort 851, segv 681, loop 1700, oom 3112, poison 518, hostabort 712, hostpoison 687. Loop throughput x0.905.
- isolation-fi --self-test --mutant-subject: PASS, 3/3 mutants red [8.6]. no-fork gave 983 wrong answers on hostpoison; no-deadline dropped loop throughput to x0.192; reuse-instance gave 188 wrong answers on poison. Both controls passed.
- isolation-fi --self-test (reference): 7/7 [8.5].
- syscall-negative on p2-subject probe: PASS, 77/77 cells [9.3].
- syscall-negative on the test-hooks aegis-p2 probe: PASS, 77/77 [8.8].
- syscall-negative --self-test: 7/7.
- Child filter install cost per fork (p2-subject forkcost, n=3000, two runs, load 4.6): p50 21.8 us, p99 25.3-25.6 us. A fork plus fresh instance plus call takes p50 167-169 us with the filter and 148-149 us without.
- An earlier --trials 3 run at load 8-53 also passed, with some timing-only re-drives.

Committed (in scope):
- aegis-iso zygote: one fork per connection. The child closes the listener, installs the child filter, arms ITIMER_REAL and exits with _exit. The mutants no-fork, no-deadline and reuse-child are behind the mutants feature.
- aegis-iso supervisor: spawns workers by execve with the listener at fd 3 and only AEGIS_P2_* in the environment. A dead worker is always replaced by a new execve.
- aegis-iso tests: zygote, supervisor respawn and compile-filter layout.
- aegis-p2 main: the config/compile dispatch is kept, and compile now runs sandboxed.
- aegis-p2 zygote: F14 ready, request, body-chunk and resp-end. test-hooks and mutants builds add the layout frame and the AEGIS_P2_TEST_LANDLOCK_ABI override (below 4 exits 78). cordon exits 78; probe exists only with test-hooks.
- p2-subject: serve forkwasm (compile, hash, re-exec, digest-checked load, zygote sandbox) and forkcost.

The real Wasmtime zygote and child needed no new syscalls.

Checks: fmt and clippy -D warnings are clean on all feature sets. cargo test passes for aegis-iso (18/18) and aegis-p2 (3/3). unsafe-sites (aegis-iso 13/20), layering and wasmtime-config check all PASS.

To save disk (the machine was down to 9.7G free), I deleted the target/p2, target/p2-mutants and target/p2-test directories after the runs.
open_issues: Blocker: crates/aegis-wasm needs the test-hooks fi module (subjects/p2-subject/aegis-wasm-fi.patch) and a one-line path-only Cargo.lock re-lock. Without both, p2-subject does not build on this commit and the gate cannot run. The integrator applies them, or gives the module to an aegis-wasm unit.

Edits outside the write scope that I committed: aegis-iso sandbox/filter.rs, landlock.rs, mod.rs and probe.rs. They add the compile profile your notes asked for (a new Kind::Compile filter = cordon layout plus fsync/fdatasync/rename*/unlink*, and a Landlock write rule on the --out directory). The denylist and the zygote, cordon and child programs are unchanged. Please review.
Acceptance command defect 1: it builds -p p2-subject -p aegis-p2 in one cargo invocation, which D18 forbids. I ran them as two separate builds. The gate command is already correct.

Acceptance command defect 2: the final step appends --path forkwasm to oracles/syscall-negative/run, and synneg.py rejects that option (exit 2, unrecognized arguments). The gate form without --path passes on all three stages.

Gaps in the F14 zygote: aegis-wasm's define_imports is still a stub (P5-wasm-002), so only modules with no imports can run. The req-head is decoded and checked but never handed to the guest. A wall timeout ends the child by SIGALRM, so no resp-end trap 2 is sent; the supervisor sees a worker death.
The no-deadline mutant cannot turn fuel off in the product engine, so it runs with fuel at the F8 ceiling (1e9) and no ITIMER_REAL. It is still caught (loop throughput x0.192).

Timing numbers are from the shared laptop under load (load average recorded with each result), so they are provisional and grade at most B. The p2-subject compile step runs unsandboxed, playing the supervisor's role; only aegis-p2 compile runs under the compile sandbox.
